title: Hanuma doubts whether Seetha dies in the fire
introduction: Making out that the whole of Lanka is reduced to ashes and conjecturing that Seetha too thus might have lost her life, Hanuma begins to reproach himself for his unrestrained exhibition of anger. Hanuma regrets that if Seetha dies now in this fire of Lanka, Rama and his brothers on hearing that report will not survive. While reflecting thus, Hanuma sees some good omens and asserts himself that Seetha can survive from the harsh forces of fire by her virtues of penance and devotion to Rama. In the meantime, he hears of her safety from the lips of Charanas (celestial bards) and feels consoled. Hanuma makes up his mind to return only after seeing her again.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे पञ्चपञ्चाशः सर्गः
Thus completes 55th Chapter of Sundara Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
संदीप्यमानाम् विध्वस्ताम् त्रस्त रक्षो गणाम् पुरीम् |
अवेक्ष्य हानुमाम्ल् लन्काम् चिन्तयामास वानरः
verses.iast:
saṃdīpyamānām vidhvastām trasta rakṣo gaṇām purīm |
avekṣya hānumāml lankām cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ
verses.translation: Seeing the city of Lanka blazing, and frightened with its multitude of demons getting alarmed, Hanuma the monkey became thoughtful.

glosses.meaning: with its troops of demons getting alarmed

verses.devanagari:
तस्य अभूत् सुमहान् त्रासः कुत्सा च आत्मनि अजायत |
लन्काम् प्रदहता कर्म किंस्वित् कृतम् इदम् मया
verses.iast:
tasya abhūt sumahān trāsaḥ kutsā ca ātmani ajāyata |
lankām pradahatā karma kiṃsvit kṛtam idam mayā
verses.translation: A great anxiety entered his mind and there arose in him a feeling of self-contempt. He said to himself "What an admonitory act has bee done by me in burning Lanka."

verses.devanagari:
धन्याः ते पुरुष श्रेष्ठ ये बुद्ध्या कोपम् उत्थितम् |
निरुन्धन्ति महात्मानो दीप्तम् अग्निम् इव अम्भसा
verses.iast:
dhanyāḥ te puruṣa śreṣṭha ye buddhyā kopam utthitam |
nirundhanti mahātmāno dīptam agnim iva ambhasā
verses.translation: "As a burning fire is extinguished with water, blessed indeed are those great-souled men of excellence, who in their wisdom, restrain their elevated fury."

verses.devanagari:
क्रुद्धः पापम् न कुर्यात्कः क्रुद्धो हन्याद्गुरूनपि |
क्रुद्धः परुषया वाचा नरः साधूनधिक्षिपेत्
verses.iast:
kruddhaḥ pāpam na kuryātkaḥ kruddho hanyādgurūnapi |
kruddhaḥ paruṣayā vācā naraḥ sādhūnadhikṣipet
verses.translation: "Which enraged man would not incur a sinful act? An enraged person may even kill his elders. An enraged person may insult virtuous men with harsh words."

verses.devanagari:
वाच्यावाच्यम् प्रकुपितो न विजानाति कर्हिचित् |
नाकार्यमस्ति क्रुद्धस्य नावाच्यम् विद्यते क्वचित्
verses.iast:
vācyāvācyam prakupito na vijānāti karhicit |
nākāryamasti kruddhasya nāvācyam vidyate kvacit
verses.translation: "An agitated person ever does not know which appropriate words are and which are forbidden words to be uttered. For enraged persons, there is neither an improper act nor ever an improper word to be spoken."

glosses.meaning: an improper word to be uttered.

verses.devanagari:
यः समुत्पतितम् क्रोधम् क्षमयैव निरस्यति |
यथोरगस्त्वचम् जीर्णाम् स वै पुरुष उच्यते
verses.iast:
yaḥ samutpatitam krodham kṣamayaiva nirasyati |
yathoragastvacam jīrṇām sa vai puruṣa ucyate
verses.translation: "As a serpent casts off its slough, whoever casts aside an intense anger sprung up in him suddenly by virtue of his endurance, he verily is said to be an excellent man."

glosses.meaning: an intense anger sprung up suddenly

verses.devanagari:
धिगस्तु माम् सुदुर्भद्धिम् निर्लज्जम् पापकृत्तमम् |
अचिन्तयित्वा ताम् सीतामग्निदम् स्वामिघातकम्
verses.iast:
dhigastu mām sudurbhaddhim nirlajjam pāpakṛttamam |
acintayitvā tām sītāmagnidam svāmighātakam
verses.translation: "Shame be upon me, the greatest sinner with utter foolishness and impudence, who became a fire-brand without giving thought to that Seetha and became hurtful to my master."

glosses.meaning: and became hurtful to me master.

verses.devanagari:
यदि दग्धा तु इयम् लन्का नूनम् आर्या अपि जानकी |
दग्धा तेन मया भर्तुः हतम् कार्यम् अजानता
verses.iast:
yadi dagdhā tu iyam lankā nūnam āryā api jānakī |
dagdhā tena mayā bhartuḥ hatam kāryam ajānatā
verses.translation: "If this whole Lanka for its part has been burnt, the worshipful Seetha too has surely been burnt. Thus, I have spolt the purpose of my lord inadvertently."

glosses.meaning: if this Lanka has been burnt

verses.devanagari:
यत् अर्थम् अयम् आरम्भः तत् कार्यम् अवसादितम् |
मया हि दहता लन्काम् न सीता परिरक्षिता
verses.iast:
yat artham ayam ārambhaḥ tat kāryam avasāditam |
mayā hi dahatā lankām na sītā parirakṣitā
verses.translation: "That purpose for which all this effort was taken, has been spoilt. At the time of burning the city, I have not saved Seetha indeed."

verses.devanagari:
ईषत् कार्यम् इदम् कार्यम् कृतम् आसीन् न संशयः |
तस्य क्रोध अभिभूतेन मया मूल क्षयः कृतः
verses.iast:
īṣat kāryam idam kāryam kṛtam āsīn na saṃśayaḥ |
tasya krodha abhibhūtena mayā mūla kṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "This task (of burning Lanka) has been fulfilled by me and it has been completed only with a small effort. Overpowered as I was with anger, the very root of that fulfillment has been destroyed by me. There is no doubt."

glosses.meaning: and was completed with only a small effort
due to overpowering of my anger

verses.devanagari:
विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तम् न हि अदग्धः प्रदृश्यते |
लन्कायाः कश्चित् उद्देशः सर्वा भस्मी कृता पुरी
verses.iast:
vinaṣṭā jānakī vyaktam na hi adagdhaḥ pradṛśyate |
lankāyāḥ kaścit uddeśaḥ sarvā bhasmī kṛtā purī
verses.translation: "The entire Lanka has been reduced to ashes. No place is seen unburnt in this City. Therefore, Seetha also must have been surely lost."

verses.devanagari:
यदि तत् विहतम् कार्यम् मया प्रज्ञा विपर्ययात् |
इह एव प्राण सम्न्यासो मम अपि हि अतिरोचते
verses.iast:
yadi tat vihatam kāryam mayā prajñā viparyayāt |
iha eva prāṇa samnyāso mama api hi atirocate
verses.translation: "If this task has been spoiled due to my perverted intelligence, it is appropriate even for me, here and now itself, to give up my life."

glosses.meaning: If that act has been spoiled

verses.devanagari:
किम् अग्नौ निपतामि अद्य आहोस्वित् वडवा मुखे |
शरीरम् आहो सत्त्वानाम् दद्मि सागर वासिनाम्
verses.iast:
kim agnau nipatāmi adya āhosvit vaḍavā mukhe |
śarīram āho sattvānām dadmi sāgara vāsinām
verses.translation: "Shall I jump into fire now or into the mouth of a submarine fire? Or shall I give up my body as a feed to the marine animals?"

glosses.meaning: into the mouth of a submarine fire?

verses.devanagari:
कथम् हि जीवता शक्यो मया द्रष्टुम् हरि ईश्वरः |
तौ वा पुरुष शार्दूलौ कार्य सर्व स्व घातिना
verses.iast:
katham hi jīvatā śakyo mayā draṣṭum hari īśvaraḥ |
tau vā puruṣa śārdūlau kārya sarva sva ghātinā
verses.translation: "By me who has ruined the entire task, how can I, even while remaining alive, see Sugreeva the Lord of monkeys or Rama and Lakshmana the best of men?"

glosses.meaning: who has spoiled the entire task

verses.devanagari:
मया खलु तत् एव इदम् रोष दोषात् प्रदर्शितम् |
प्रथितम् त्रिषु लोकेषु कपितम् अनवस्थितम्
verses.iast:
mayā khalu tat eva idam roṣa doṣāt pradarśitam |
prathitam triṣu lokeṣu kapitam anavasthitam
verses.translation: "Due to culpability of my anger, I have indeed shown this apishness that is famous for instability in the three worlds."

glosses.meaning: due to culpability of my anger

verses.devanagari:
धिग् अस्तु राजसम् भावम् अनीशम् अनवस्थितम् |
ईश्वरेण अपि यत् रागान् मया सीता न रक्षिता
verses.iast:
dhig astu rājasam bhāvam anīśam anavasthitam |
īśvareṇa api yat rāgān mayā sītā na rakṣitā
verses.translation: "Let there be shame upon the passionate way of my thinking, which breeds helplessness and instability. fir, eventhough capable as I am, Seetha could not be saved by me due to my exciting passion of anger."

glosses.meaning: due to my exciting passion of anger.

verses.devanagari:
विनष्टायाम् तु सीतायाम् ताव् उभौ विनशिष्यतः |
तयोः विनाशे सुग्रीवः सबन्धुः विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
vinaṣṭāyām tu sītāyām tāv ubhau vinaśiṣyataḥ |
tayoḥ vināśe sugrīvaḥ sabandhuḥ vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: "If Seetha dies, those two princes, Rama and Lakshmana will die. If their death occurs, Sugreeva along with his associates will also die."

verses.devanagari:
एतत् एव वचः श्रुत्वा भरतो भ्रातृ वत्सलः |
धर्म आत्मा सह शत्रुघ्नः कथम् शक्ष्यति जीवितुम्
verses.iast:
etat eva vacaḥ śrutvā bharato bhrātṛ vatsalaḥ |
dharma ātmā saha śatrughnaḥ katham śakṣyati jīvitum
verses.translation: "How can the virtuous Bharata together with Shatrughna, who are affectionate to his brother, survive after hearing this news?"

glosses.meaning: who are affectionate to his brother

verses.devanagari:
इक्ष्वाकु वंशे धर्मिष्ठे गते नाशम् असंशयम् |
भविष्यन्ति प्रजाः सर्वाः शोक सम्ताप पीडिताः
verses.iast:
ikṣvāku vaṃśe dharmiṣṭhe gate nāśam asaṃśayam |
bhaviṣyanti prajāḥ sarvāḥ śoka samtāpa pīḍitāḥ
verses.translation: "When the virtuous Ikshvaku dynasty perishes, all the people will undoubtedly be tormented with anguish and affliction."

glosses.meaning: ikSvaaku vamshe = (when) the virtuous Ikshvaku dynasty

verses.devanagari:
तत् अहम् भाग्य रहितो लुप्त धर्म अर्थ सम्ग्रहः |
रोग दोष परीत आत्मा व्यक्तम् लोक विनाशनः
verses.iast:
tat aham bhāgya rahito lupta dharma artha samgrahaḥ |
roga doṣa parīta ātmā vyaktam loka vināśanaḥ
verses.translation: "Therefore, I, the unfortunate being, deprived of the values of duty and interest, with my mind filled with culpability of anger, clearly became the destroyer of the world."

glosses.meaning: deprived of the values of duty and interest
having my mind filled with culpability of anger
became the destroyer of the world.

verses.devanagari:
इति चिन्तयतः तस्य निमित्तानि उपपेदिरे |
पूरम् अपि उपलब्धानि साक्षात् पुनः अचिन्तयत्
verses.iast:
iti cintayataḥ tasya nimittāni upapedire |
pūram api upalabdhāni sākṣāt punaḥ acintayat
verses.translation: While thinking thus, Hanuma clearly saw some omens, whose welcome-results had already been directly experienced by him and again thought (as follows);

verses.devanagari:
अथवा चारु सर्व अन्गी रक्षिता स्वेन तेजसा |
न नशिष्यति कल्याणी न अग्निः अग्नौ प्रवर्तते
verses.iast:
athavā cāru sarva angī rakṣitā svena tejasā |
na naśiṣyati kalyāṇī na agniḥ agnau pravartate
verses.translation: "Or else, Seetha the auspicious lady, who is completely charming of her limbs and protected by her own effulgence, does not get destroyed. Fire does not indeed destroy fire!"

glosses.meaning: protected svena tejasaa = by her own effulgence
doe no do injury agnau = into fire.

verses.devanagari:
न हि धर्मात् मनः तस्य भार्याम् अमित तेजसः |
स्व चारित्र अभिगुप्ताम् ताम् स्प्रष्टुम् अर्हति पावकः
verses.iast:
na hi dharmāt manaḥ tasya bhāryām amita tejasaḥ |
sva cāritra abhiguptām tām spraṣṭum arhati pāvakaḥ

glosses.meaning: and protected by her own good conduct.

verses.devanagari:
नूनम् राम प्रभावेन वैदेह्याः सुकृतेन च |
यन् माम् दहन कर्मा अयम् न अदहद्त् हव्य वाहनः
verses.iast:
nūnam rāma prabhāvena vaidehyāḥ sukṛtena ca |
yan mām dahana karmā ayam na adahadt havya vāhanaḥ
verses.translation: "If this fire with its burning nature is not igniting me, it is surely due to the power of Rama and the benevolence of Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
त्रयाणाम् भरत आदीनाम् भ्रातृऋणाम् देवता च या |
रामस्य च मनः कान्ता सा कथम् विनशिष्यति
verses.iast:
trayāṇām bharata ādīnām bhrātṛṛṇām devatā ca yā |
rāmasya ca manaḥ kāntā sā katham vinaśiṣyati
verses.translation: "How should that Seetha, who is a godhead for the three brothers (of Rama) starting with Bharata and who is dear to the heart of Rama perish?"

verses.devanagari:
यत् वा दहन कर्मा अयम् सर्वत्र प्रभुः अव्ययः |
न मे दहति लान्गूलम् कथम् आर्याम् प्रधक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
yat vā dahana karmā ayam sarvatra prabhuḥ avyayaḥ |
na me dahati lāngūlam katham āryām pradhakṣyati
verses.translation: "This fire, which spreads everywhere without any hindrance, is not burning my tail. How can it burn the venerable Seetha?"

verses.devanagari:
पुनश्चाचिन्तयत्तत्र हनुमान्विस्मितस्तदा |
हिरण्यनाभस्य गिरेर्जलमध्ये प्रदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
punaścācintayattatra hanumānvismitastadā |
hiraṇyanābhasya girerjalamadhye pradarśanam
verses.translation: Hanuma then recalled with wonder the sight of Mount Mainaka (having gold in its cavities) in the midst of sea-water there.

glosses.meaning: of Mount Mainaka (having gold in its cavities)

verses.devanagari:
तपसा सत्य वाक्येन अनन्यत्वाच् च भर्तरि |
अपि सा निर्दहेत् अग्निम् न ताम् अग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
tapasā satya vākyena ananyatvāc ca bhartari |
api sā nirdahet agnim na tām agniḥ pradhakṣyati
verses.translation: "That Seetha can even burn away the fire by her penance, true utterances and undivided devotion towards her husband. Fire does not ignite her."

verses.devanagari:
स तथा चिन्तयन् तत्र देव्या धर्म परिग्रहम् |
शुश्राव हनुमान् वाक्यम् चारणानाम् महात्मनाम्
verses.iast:
sa tathā cintayan tatra devyā dharma parigraham |
śuśrāva hanumān vākyam cāraṇānām mahātmanām
verses.translation: Hanuma, who was thus thinking there about the overpowering virtue of Seetha, happened to hear the words of the high-souled charanas (heavenly bards).

verses.devanagari:
अहो खलु कृतम् कर्म दुर्विषह्यम् हनूमता |
अग्निम् विसृजता अभीक्ष्णम् भीमम् राक्षस सद्मनि
verses.iast:
aho khalu kṛtam karma durviṣahyam hanūmatā |
agnim visṛjatā abhīkṣṇam bhīmam rākṣasa sadmani
verses.translation: "Alas! Hanuma, who hurled a very terrific fire into Ravana's house, has indeed done a difficult act."

verses.devanagari:
प्रपलायितरक्षः स्त्रीबाल वृद्धसमाकुला |
जनकोलाहलाध्माता क्रन्दन्तीवाद्रिकन्दरैः
verses.iast:
prapalāyitarakṣaḥ strībāla vṛddhasamākulā |
janakolāhalādhmātā krandantīvādrikandaraiḥ
verses.translation: "The city of Lanka, full of demons their wives, children and elders running hither and thither, as also filled with an uproar of people, appears as if it weeping through its mountain-caves."

glosses.meaning: (the city of Lanka) full of demons
and filled with an uproar of people
appears like weeping adrikandaraiH = through its mountain-caves.

verses.devanagari:
दग्धा इयम् नगरी लन्का साट्ट प्राकार तोरणा |
जानकी न च दग्धा इति विस्मयो अद्भुत एव नः
verses.iast:
dagdhā iyam nagarī lankā sāṭṭa prākāra toraṇā |
jānakī na ca dagdhā iti vismayo adbhuta eva naḥ
verses.translation: "It is just so surprising a marvel to us that the entire City with its market-places, ramparts and arched door-ways, was burnt, but Seetha alone was not burnt."

verses.devanagari:
स निमित्तैः च दृष्ट अर्थैः कारणैः च महागुणैः |
ऋषि वाक्यैः च हनुमान् अभवत् प्रीत मानसः
verses.iast:
sa nimittaiḥ ca dṛṣṭa arthaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ ca mahāguṇaiḥ |
ṛṣi vākyaiḥ ca hanumān abhavat prīta mānasaḥ
verses.translation: That Hanuma became delighted in his mind, by seeing the omens, with their apparent advantages in them and very high qualities of their origin as also the words of those sages.

glosses.meaning: and by the words of the sages.

verses.devanagari:
ततः कपिः प्राप्त मनो रथ अर्थः |
ताम् अक्षताम् राज सुताम् विदित्वा |
प्रत्यक्षतः ताम् पुनः एव दृष्ट्वा |
प्रतिप्रयाणाय मतिम् चकार
verses.iast:
tataḥ kapiḥ prāpta mano ratha arthaḥ |
tām akṣatām rāja sutām viditvā |
pratyakṣataḥ tām punaḥ eva dṛṣṭvā |
pratiprayāṇāya matim cakāra
verses.translation: Then, Hanuma, having fulfilled his object of desire by learning that Seetha the princess remains uninjured, made up his mind to return only after seeing her personally yet again.

glosses.meaning: having fulfilled his object of desire
by learning taam raajasutaam = that Seetha the princess
